component.summary: AI patent agent for prior art, freedom to operate and drafting

description.p: FlowLeap is an AI patent agent for patent professionals. It runs prior-art and freedom-to-operate searches, builds invalidity charts, drafts office-action responses and helps write applications, grounded in EPO, USPTO and PATSTAT data. See https://www.flowleap.co/ for documentation and downloads.
